Create a digital guestbook check-in form (for example, for a platform such as Takemi) using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The form must perform client-side validation before the data is submitted.
hint:
Requirements

  • Input Fields: Full Name, Email Address, and WhatsApp Number.
  • Validation Rules: All fields are mandatory. Email must use a valid format (example: user@email.com). WhatsApp Number must contain numbers only and have at least 10 digits.
  • Visual Feedback: Do not use the browser’s default validation popup. Display a custom red error message directly below each invalid field.
  • Design: Apply a clean, modern UI using CSS. The form should be easy to read and visually consistent.
  • Submit Behavior: If any field is invalid, prevent submission and show the relevant inline error message(s).
